verses.text: [A Psalm] of Praise, of David. I will extol You, my God, O King, And I will bless Your name forever and ever.
verses.textZh: （大衛的讚美詩。）我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！

verses.text: Every day I will bless You, And I will praise Your name forever and ever.
verses.textZh: 我要天天稱頌你，也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！

verses.text: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised, And His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.textZh: 耶和華本為大，該受大讚美；其大無法測度。

verses.text: One generation shall praise Your works to another, And shall declare Your mighty acts.
verses.textZh: 這代要對那代頌讚你的作為，也要傳揚你的大能。

verses.text: On the glorious splendor of Your majesty And on Your wonderful works, I will meditate.
verses.textZh: 我要默念你威嚴的尊榮和你奇妙的作為。

verses.text: Men shall speak of the power of Your awesome acts, And I will tell of Your greatness.
verses.textZh: 人要傳說你可畏之事的能力；我也要傳揚你的大德。

verses.text: They shall eagerly utter the memory of Your abundant goodness And will shout joyfully of Your righteousness.
verses.textZh: 他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來，並要歌唱你的公義。

verses.text: The LORD is gracious and merciful; Slow to anger and great in lovingkindness.
verses.textZh: 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。

verses.text: The LORD is good to all, And His mercies are over all His works.
verses.textZh: 耶和華善待萬民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。

verses.text: All Your works shall give thanks to You, O LORD, And Your godly ones shall bless You.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你；你的聖民也要稱頌你，

verses.text: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom And talk of Your power;
verses.textZh: 傳說你國的榮耀，談論你的大能，

verses.text: To make known to the sons of men Your mighty acts And the glory of the majesty of Your kingdom.
verses.textZh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作為，並你國度威嚴的榮耀。

verses.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion [endures] throughout all generations.
verses.textZh: 你的國是永遠的國！你執掌的權柄存到萬代！

verses.text: The LORD sustains all who fall And raises up all who are bowed down.
verses.textZh: 凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持；凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。

verses.text: The eyes of all look to You, And You give them their food in due time.
verses.textZh: 萬民都舉目仰望你；你隨時給他們食物。

verses.text: You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.textZh: 你張手，使有生氣的都隨願飽足。

verses.text: The LORD is righteous in all His ways And kind in all His deeds.
verses.textZh: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義；在他一切所做的都有慈愛。

verses.text: The LORD is near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.
verses.textZh: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的，耶和華便與他們相近。

verses.text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He will also hear their cry and will save them.
verses.textZh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願，也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。

verses.text: The LORD keeps all who love Him, But all the wicked He will destroy.
verses.textZh: 耶和華保護一切愛他的人，卻要滅絕一切的惡人。

verses.text: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, And all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.
verses.textZh: 我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話；惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
